# taxaudit

[![License:
MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

Publication-grade R package for ontology-mapped botanical trait
extraction, agreement auditing, and leakage-free evaluation.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 📦 Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("AamnaNaveed/taxaudit")
```

### **Quick Start**

library(taxaudit)

### Load benchmark corpus & extract traits

corpus \<- ta_load_corpus() traits \<-
ta_extract_traits(corpus\$text\[1\])

### Audit agreement & baseline comparison

agreement \<- ta_audit_agreement(corpus) comparison \<-
ta_compare_baseline(corpus)

### Leakage-free evaluation

eval_results \<- ta_split_evaluation(corpus, split_by = “taxon”)

## Features

- Plant Ontology (PO:0025034) alignment with exact character start/end
  span tracking.

- Inter-annotator agreement auditing (ta_audit_agreement).

- Leakage-free taxon-held-out cross-validation (ta_split_evaluation).

- Baseline comparison module against naive regex (ta_compare_baseline).

- Fully passes R CMD check with 0 errors \| 0 warnings \| 0 notes.

## 📄 License

MIT © Aamna Naveed

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calculate_DI()`](calculate_DI.md) : Calculate Pairwise
  Diagnosability Index
- [`extract_description()`](extract_description.md) : Extract
  Description for a Given Taxon
- [`ta_audit_agreement()`](ta_audit_agreement.md) : Calculate Agreement
  and Overlap Between Two Annotation Sets
- [`ta_baseline_extract()`](ta_baseline_extract.md) : Baseline Keyword
  Trait Extraction
- [`ta_compare_baseline()`](ta_compare_baseline.md) : Compare Baseline
  vs Ontology-Mapped Extraction
- [`ta_contrast_table()`](ta_contrast_table.md) : Generate a contrast
  table comparing character states between two taxon treatments
- [`ta_extract_characters()`](ta_extract_characters.md) : Extract
  characters from taxon description text with expanded ontology
- [`ta_extract_traits()`](ta_extract_traits.md) : Extract Traits with
  Evidence Spans and Ontology Terms
- [`ta_fetch_treatment()`](ta_fetch_treatment.md) : Fetch botanical
  treatment text for a given taxon
- [`ta_generate_report()`](ta_generate_report.md) : Generate Automated
  Taxonomic Audit Report
- [`ta_get_ontology()`](ta_get_ontology.md) : Define standard botanical
  character ontology for Flora audits
- [`ta_load_corpus()`](ta_load_corpus.md) : Load the Expert-Annotated
  Benchmark Corpus
- [`ta_pairwise_di()`](ta_pairwise_di.md) : Calculate Pairwise
  Diagnosability Index (DI) between two species character profiles
- [`ta_parse_treatment()`](ta_parse_treatment.md) : Parse a cached
  taxonomic treatment HTML file
- [`ta_plot_heatmap()`](ta_plot_heatmap.md) : Plot Pairwise
  Diagnosability Index Heatmap
- [`ta_resolve_names()`](ta_resolve_names.md) : Resolve and Standardize
  Taxonomic Names
- [`ta_run_audit()`](ta_run_audit.md) : Run a complete botanical trait
  audit for a taxon
- [`ta_run_batch_audit()`](ta_run_batch_audit.md) : Run taxonomic audit
  across multiple treatment URLs
- [`ta_split_evaluation()`](ta_split_evaluation.md) : Split Corpus Data
  for Held-Out Evaluation
